title: Upgrade: v1.10.0-remove-ibc
summary:
Removes IBC and Osmosis bridge support from Mirage.

Changes:
- Removes all IBC module integration (transfer, client, connection, channel)
- Removes Osmosis from bridge_chains configuration
- Removes MsgIBCTransfer message type
- Renames MsgMintTo to MsgMintTokens (field: recipient → target)
- Adds MsgBurnTokens for governance-controlled token burns
- Cleans up Hermes relayer tooling and configs

The Solana attested bridge remains fully functional.

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to v1.10.0 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
